title: Scene conditioning reveals whether EE+joint motion explains local visual change
core_answer: The probe is driven by scene context without independent additive EE/joint value, so this experiment does not support a physical-to-visual mediator.

ridge.selection: lowest mean leave-one-init-out RMSE; exact tie chooses larger alpha

p3.architecture: 10->64 physical no-bias; 256->64 sigmoid context gate; elementwise product; 64->512 no-bias
